# Birky Studio

> Birky Studio sells and installs done-for-you AI automation for small businesses: a base AI agent that catches and qualifies leads from website and WhatsApp, saves them to a Notion CRM, answers instantly in English and Spanish and follows up on its own, plus add-on blocks (text and voice AI receptionists, review engine, lead generation, outreach, Google Business Profile autopilot, content engine) and professional bilingual websites. Luna Jerney builds and installs everything herself.

## Products (AI automation)

- [Base Agent](https://birkystudio.com/products/ai-agent-setup/): Catches every enquiry from your site and WhatsApp, qualifies it, saves it to Notion, answers instantly and follows up. Notion CRM included, bilingual EN/ES, live in about 15 minutes. One-time from $1,297 solo, from $2,997 with a team.
- [AI Text Receptionist](https://birkystudio.com/products/text-receptionist/): Answers your WhatsApp day and night. One-time $297. Works on its own.
- [AI Voice Receptionist](https://birkystudio.com/products/voice-receptionist/): Answers your phone in a natural voice 24/7. One-time $550, plus Vapi call usage paid by the client.
- [Free 15-Minute Audit](https://birkystudio.com/products/free-audit/): One short call and we name the one thing costing you the most time. Free.
- [Custom Assessment](https://birkystudio.com/products/custom-assessment/): A 45-minute interview and a written plan, measured in hours saved. Solo $349, business $999. Fee credits against your blocks.
- [Review Engine](https://birkystudio.com/products/review-engine/): Turns past clients into Google reviews. One-time $497 plus $97/mo.
- [Lead Generation Starter List](https://birkystudio.com/products/lead-generation-starter-list/): A real, scored list of prospects you own forever, from $497.
- [Lead Generation Pack](https://birkystudio.com/products/lead-generation-pack/): Verified prospects plus the outreach and follow-up that work them. One-time $1,997.
- [Outreach Engine](https://birkystudio.com/products/outreach-engine/): Sends the compliant email follow-up for you. One-time $797.
- [GBP Autopilot](https://birkystudio.com/products/gbp-autopilot/): Keeps your Google Business Profile posting. One-time $397.
- [Content Engine](https://birkystudio.com/products/content-engine/): Blog and SEO content written and published for you. One-time $497.

## Products (websites)

- [Starter Website](https://birkystudio.com/products/website-starter/): 1 to 3 pages, new businesses. $499.
- [Professional Website](https://birkystudio.com/products/website-professional/): Growing businesses, bilingual EN/ES. $999.
- [Premium Website](https://birkystudio.com/products/website-premium/): Established businesses, 10+ pages with a blog. $1,999.
- [Self-Editing CMS](https://birkystudio.com/products/self-editing-cms/): Update text and photos yourself, no coding. $130.

## Care and support

- [Care and Maintenance](https://birkystudio.com/products/care-maintenance/): Ongoing support after install, $97/mo.
- [Business AI Partner](https://birkystudio.com/products/business-ai-partner/): Full ongoing partnership, $197/mo.
